scope: CPU-only saved first-episode trace analysis; no acceptance thresholds changed

acceptance_reference.scope: Final fixed-case, repeated randomized-reset Go2 staircase validation

smoothness.pitch: Report relative to staircase grade; do not impose flat-world horizontal posture
smoothness.candidate_comparison: Compare action second differences and root jerk at equal geometry/speed with a competent baseline; preserve completion and tracking

acceptance_reference.limitations: Reset randomization alone is not full dynamics or real-robot validation; material and actuator sensitivity reported separately

geometry.collision_representation: closed triangle meshes with physical overhang undersides
closed triangle meshes with physical overhang undersides

trace_cadence.limit: Camera frame rate is independent of trace cadence; sampled peaks are lower bounds.

outcome.limit: Failure labels come from evaluator; falls also include non-escape termination.

progress.limit: Trace endpoints can precede true terminal state; source outcome retains actual pre-reset endpoint.

tracking.note: Yaw-only projection is a tracking proxy on pitched stairs; authoritative full-body-frame errors are source case metrics.

pauses.limit: Sparse low-vx hits cannot establish continuous pause duration; use source policy-cadence longest_flight_pause_s.

action_delta_rms.scope: Recorded one-policy-step differences sampled at trace timestamps; never differences across sparse action snapshots.

action_second_delta_rms.scope: Recorded one-policy-step differences sampled at trace timestamps; never differences across sparse action snapshots.

foot_contacts.scope: Trace-sample contact flags after evaluator warmup; neither exact contact duration nor exact touchdown timing.

foot_retractions.scope: Course/world-x foot-center decrease between adjacent recorded root-flight samples; normal gait corrections also qualify.

selected_leg_forces.pose_and_vector_limit: Current vector and body-link world pose are timestamped at the policy boundary; a retained-history peak may occur at an earlier substep. Quaternion order is xyzw. No contact point or collider identity is inferred.
selected_leg_forces.measurement: Per-body world-frame net normal-force vector norm; tangential friction excluded

limits: Source case statistics cover all measured policy steps; trace statistics cover only recorded active samples.
Current/history contact and foot-link horizontal speed are proxies, not exact scraping/slip duration.
Sparse action snapshots are never differentiated; recorded policy-step action differences are retained.
Named leg force is never reconstructed from aggregate shank force.
Low action variation in a stalled policy does not establish smooth traversal.
This analysis does not replace continuous video review, unseen-case validation or material/dynamics tests.
